suppress.notes: CVE-2026-47838 (SubjectDnX509PrincipalExtractor, CN parsing). Reported by Sonatype OSS Index for spring-security-web 7.1.2. Spring's advisory (https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47838) lists 5.7.x-6.5.10 as affected; 7.0.x was addressed under CVE-2026-22747; no 7.1.x version is listed. gatekeeper does not use SubjectDnX509PrincipalExtractor: SecurityConfig sets its own SubjectAttributePrincipalExtractor through x509PrincipalExtractor(...). Decision 2026-10-31, reviewer Niklas Gillström. Re-review when spring-security-web changes version.

CVE-2026-47842 (AesBytesEncryptor, all-zero IV in CBC mode). Reported by Sonatype OSS Index for spring-security-crypto 7.1.2. Spring's advisory (https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47842) lists 7.1.0 as the only affected 7.1.x version and 7.1.1 as fixed. No code in this repository uses AesBytesEncryptor or Encryptors. Decision 2026-10-31, reviewer Niklas Gillström. Re-review when spring-security-crypto changes version.
